title: SectionVersion
description: One bi-temporal slice of a section's wording (PROCUREMENT_PLAN §2.2 Table 2): verbatim for the current slice, reverse-reconstructed only where unambiguous, else unavailable

section_number.description: Official label as published e.g. Section 376.

slug.description: Section slug as in the sections table

heading.description: Marginal heading in force during the slice; null when the slice's wording is unavailable

full_text.description: Wording in force during the slice; null exactly when text_status is unavailable

valid_to.description: The next slice's valid_from; null for the open-ended last slice

status.description: unknown: an interval before the first date the section's wording can be asserted (an amendment of the Act, linked or not, or an undated one, may lie in it); its text is unavailable

amendment_event_ids.description: amendment_events ids (or judicial_events ids, for a ruling) that opened the slice; [] for the first slice

change_summary.description: e.g. Substituted by Act 13 of 2013, s. 9

source_url.description: Permalink to the frozen v0.1.1 sections table the text was read from, #section id

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the source section text
